# edgeos_dhcp_static_mapping (Resource)

A fixed address for one client in a DHCP subnet (`service dhcp-server shared-network-name <shared_network> subnet <subnet> static-mapping <name>`).

Reference `edgeos_dhcp_shared_network` in `shared_network` so Terraform creates the shared network first and deletes the mapping before it. Destroying the resource deletes the mapping node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "edgeos_dhcp_shared_network" "lan" {
  name = "LAN"

  subnets = {
    "192.168.1.0/24" = {
      default_router = "192.168.1.1"
      dns_servers    = ["192.168.1.1"]
      ranges = [
        { start = "192.168.1.100", stop = "192.168.1.199" },
      ]
    }
  }
}

resource "edgeos_dhcp_static_mapping" "printer" {
  shared_network = edgeos_dhcp_shared_network.lan.name
  subnet         = "192.168.1.0/24"
  name           = "printer"
  ip_address     = "192.168.1.20"
  mac_address    = "02:00:5e:00:53:20"
}

resource "edgeos_dhcp_static_mapping" "nas" {
  shared_network = edgeos_dhcp_shared_network.lan.name
  subnet         = "192.168.1.0/24"
  name           = "nas"
  ip_address     = "192.168.1.21"
  mac_address    = "02:00:5e:00:53:21"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_address` (String) Address given to the client. It must be inside `subnet`; it may be inside or outside the pools.
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address of the client in lower case, such as `02:00:5e:00:53:20`.
- `name` (String) Name of the mapping, such as `printer`. Changing it creates a new mapping.
- `shared_network` (String) Name of the shared network, usually `edgeos_dhcp_shared_network.x.name`. Changing it creates a new mapping.
- `subnet` (String) Subnet in CIDR notation, one of the keys of the shared network's `subnets`. Changing it creates a new mapping.

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean) Keep the mapping in the config but switch it off (the `disable` node). Defaults to `false`.
- `static_mapping_parameters` (List of String) Raw ISC dhcpd statements added to the host block (`static-mapping-parameters`). Write double quotes as `&quot;`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<shared_network>:<subnet>:<name>`, for example `LAN:192.168.1.0/24:printer`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = edgeos_dhcp_static_mapping.printer
  id = "LAN:192.168.1.0/24:printer"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <shared network>:<subnet>:<name>
terraform import edgeos_dhcp_static_mapping.printer 'LAN:192.168.1.0/24:printer'
```
